title: C4.1.6 coding band: R30 to R40

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

verified.note: Helper table; band 'R30 to R40' as printed in C4.1.6.

notes: Engine helper, not a published table: true where the clause's coding band applies, false otherwise (default false). Used as a condition inside the concession exceptions on C4.1.1, C4.1.1-r1, C4.1.1-r4 and C4.1.1-r7 (a table-lookup with no fact answers MEETS when the value is truthy), because exceptions cannot carry a coding of their own. Values are never null so a composite condition cannot pass on NOT_APPLICABLE. C4.1.6: gold-level accessible (C2.7.1) or small dwelling (C2.9.1) at R30 to R40. Chapter 3 text (p53) is the same as Chapter 2.
